QUOTE: On a channel-archived websocket event, the current user is kicked out if the channel is open and their membership is removed. When viewable, the channel is left in place with `delete_at` set.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: Row 1 states that when not viewable, the user is kicked out of the current channel and their membership is removed. When viewable, the channel is kept with `delete_at` set, which matches "marked deleted".
